environment.description: Same Actix-web binary deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in COUNT mode EXCEPT SqliExtendedPatternsBody and SqliUnsafeQueryString which are in BLOCK mode via rule action override. Additionally, the ALB has a fixed-response listener rule that injects a response header via Lambda@Edge-equivalent mechanism (ALB action: fixed headers on all 2xx responses) adding `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; object-src 'none'` to every response. The CSP header uses nonce-less strict policy without 'unsafe-inline' for script-src, meaning any injected <script> tags from reflected XSS via SQL injection second-order output would be blocked by the browser. Note: the SQLi WAF rule SqliUnsafeQueryString specifically targets query string parameters with SQL meta-characters in BLOCK mode.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with response header injection
config.waf: AWS WAFv2 WebACL with AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet (SqliUnsafeQueryString in BLOCK mode, others in COUNT)
config.csp_injection_point: ALB fixed-response header rule applied to all 2xx responses
config.network: VPC private subnet, ALB in public subnet, Fargate tasks in private subnet
